facts.statement: Fossils of Malarguesaurus were discovered in the Portezuelo Formation of the Neuquén Group in Argentina.
facts.quote: Its fossils, consisting of tail vertebrae, chevrons, ribs, and limb bones, were found in the upper Turonian-lower Coniacian Portezuelo Formation of the Neuquén Group.

facts.statement: The type species Malarguesaurus florenciae was described by González Riga and colleagues in 2008.
facts.quote: La especie tipo, fue descrita por González Riga et al. en 2008 y se denomina M. florenciae.

facts.statement: Malarguesaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 89 million years ago, between the Turonian and Coniacian stages.
facts.quote: que vivió a fines del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 89 millones de años, entre el Turoniense y el Coniaciense

facts.statement: The fossil record for Malarguesaurus spans from 89.8 to 85.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Coniacian to Coniacian (89.8 to 85.7 million years ago)

facts.statement: Malarguesaurus is classified as a titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur.
Malarguesaurus is described as a robust sauropod.
Like other members of its family, Malarguesaurus was a large quadrupedal herbivore.
facts.quote: Como otros de su familia, Malarguesaurus fue un gran cuadrúpedo herbívoro

facts.statement: Malarguesaurus likely reached a length of 18 meters and a weight of 20 tonnes.
facts.quote: posiblemente llegó a medir 18 metros de largo y a pesar 20 toneladas

facts.statement: Malarguesaurus possessed anterior and middle caudal vertebrae of the procero-opisthoplatic type, associated with posterior procercal caudal vertebrae.
facts.quote: Posee vértebras caudales anteriores y medias de tipo procélica-opistoplática, asociadas a vértebras caudales posteriores procélicas.

facts.statement: Research by Mannion et al. in 2013 more precisely recovered Malarguesaurus as a member of the subclade Somphospondyli.
facts.quote: Mannion et al. (2013) more precisely recovered it as a member of Somphospondyli.

rejected.statement: A study published by Previtera in 2026 examined the bone histology and growth patterns of Malarguesaurus florenciae.
rejected.quote: A study on the bone histology and growth patterns of Malarguesaurus florenciae is published by Previtera (2026).
